error.release_limit_exceeded: Too many secrets were requested in a short time, so the vault was locked as a precaution. Unlock it to continue.
error.vault_locked: The vault is locked. Unlock it to continue.
error.item_not_found: This item is no longer in the vault. Sync the vault and try again.
error.field_empty: This item has no value for that field.

error.field_not_copyable: This field can be shown but not copied.
error.clipboard_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard. Check that wl-clipboard is installed.
error.invalid_request: The omawarden engine rejected the request.
error.release_failed: The omawarden engine could not release this value.
error.release_timed_out: The omawarden engine did not respond in time.
error.release_mismatched: The omawarden engine answered a different request. Try again.
error.engine_not_redacting: The installed omawarden engine sent secrets with the vault list, so the list was discarded. Install the hardened omawarden %1 or later and unlock again.
status.secret_copied: Copied %1 to the clipboard (clears in %2 s).
